entities.summary: El Salvador is a sovereign nation in Central America, Americas. Its capital is San Salvador. Official languages include Spanish. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 6.4 million. Area: 21,041 km². Comprehensive index for El Salvador covering Joya de Cerén ('Pompeii of the Americas'), Ilopango eruption 431 CE, Pipil/Nahua migration, Maya influences, Alvarado conquest, cacao/indigo colonial economy, independence 1821, coffee oligarchy ('14 families'), 1932 La Matanza massacre (~30,000 indigenous killed, Farabundo Martí), civil war 1980-92 (~75,000 dead, death squads, Oscar Romero assassination), MS-13/Barrio 18 gangs, and Bukele's authoritarian anti-gang crackdown.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: El Salvador's tumultuous history has had a profound impact on Central America, with the 1932 La Matanza massacre resulting in the deaths of approximately 30,000 indigenous people and contributing to the country's ongoing struggle for social justice. The civil war that followed claimed an estimated 75,000 lives and left lasting scars on the nation.
